records.reason: The abstract reports a new Caucasian sample and directly tests AIS susceptibility and progression outcomes for the ESR1 XbaI polymorphism. It concludes that none of the previously reported associations could be confirmed. Wu et al. (2006) is the supplied source reference whose title identifies susceptibility to AIS; the only supplied shipped original is Inoue et al. (2002), a distinct paper on curve severity. The specifically listed prior adjudication file was not present at its path, so no prior objection text was available to inspect.

records.omission_quote: There was no significant difference in alleles (p=0.63) and genotype frequency (p=0.35) between AIS patients (AA n=95, AG n=141, GG n=50) and controls (AA n=31, AG n=66, GG n=19).
